# HiBid Enhancer Suite attribution

Flippah's US deal-intelligence implementation adapts maintained parsing,
condition-assessment, retail-matching, batching, caching, fee-math, and verdict
ideas from [hibid-enhancer-suite](https://github.com/dgomesbr/hibid-enhancer-suite).

- Upstream revision reviewed: `976913421c3fd23b48cc8ca4cde78cb9528f97d3`
- Upstream author: Diego Magalhaes
- Upstream license: MIT
- Flippah changes: TypeScript port; US/USD and Amazon.com behavior; Flippah
  storage, popup, calculator, and export integration; no donor page rewrite.

The upstream project is not bundled or executed as a second userscript. The
ported logic is maintained in Flippah's source tree.
